name: component-states
goal: Show supported visual states as revision-bound screenshots, including error states.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Visual entities use States galleries of declared runtime states and viewports, including error content. Keep commit comparisons, capture gaps and detailed verification disclosures.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Existing visual navigation tests check one selected screenshot and diagnostics, not a complete state gallery. Extend their shared matrix with error-state images and viewport checks.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Committed visual matrix fails at 51f5137c: b325dd70. The same 1,262 frozen inputs pass at af13ab15: 530afede.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Shared States gallery uses revision-bound screenshots, viewport selection and explicit gaps; diagnostics remain available in a disclosure.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Clean snapshots prove missing States at 51f5137c and passing states at af13ab15 using identical frozen inputs and command.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
steps.evidence: Reports checks and browser acceptance pass; root types, lint and unit checks pass. Full aggregate verification includes paused native Electron work, so this step stays pending.
